searchText: LEAD BY EXAMPLE When you deal damage to an adversary, you can mark a Stress and describe how you encourage your allies. The next PC to make an attack against that adversary can clear a Stress or gain a Hope.

title: Unbreakable
searchText: UNBREAKABLE When you mark your last Hit Point, instead of making a death move, you canroll adé and clear a number of Hit Points equal to the result. Then place this card in your vault.

title: Unyielding Armor
searchText: UNYIELDING ARMOR When you would mark an Armor Slot, roll a number of d6és equal to your Proficiency. If any roll a 6, reduce the severity by one threshold without marking an Armor Slot.
